prompt: A kart race for up to four players around a looping track with walls, three laps, boost pads and bots.
A side-view platformer where players race to collect coins on floating ledges; first to ten wins.
Sumo on a round platform: players dash into each other to push them off the edge; last one standing wins the round.
A co-op twin-stick shooter: waves of enemies come from the edges of an arena and players shoot them with the right stick.
A game of tag: one player is it and glows red; touching someone passes it on; whoever is it the least time wins after two minutes.
King of the hill: a glowing zone moves every 20 seconds; standing in it alone earns points.
Multiplayer snake on a grid seen from above: eat food to grow, crash into a tail or wall and you respawn shorter.
A vertical climb: the lava rises slowly and players must jump up moving platforms to stay above it.
Two-versus-two football with a ball that bounces off players and walls; first to three goals.
Dodgeball: balls spawn in the middle, pick one up and throw it; a hit player is out for five seconds.
A seeded maze seen from above; the first player to reach the exit wins; new maze every round.
Tank battle: tanks drive with the left stick, aim the turret with the right stick, and shells bounce once off walls.
Fruit falls from trees; each player has a basket and catches as much as possible; rotten fruit costs points.
Hot potato: a bomb with a hidden timer is passed by touching; whoever holds it when it explodes is out.
Asteroids for several players in one shared view: ships rotate and thrust, shoot rocks that split.
Hide and seek in a small town of box houses at dusk with street lights; seekers have torches.
Mini golf: players take turns aiming and hitting a ball over a short course with ramps and walls; fewest strokes wins.
Players paint the floor tiles they walk over in their colour; most tiles after 90 seconds wins.
Co-op night survival: zombies (Warp Humans) shamble towards the players, who swing bats; survive five minutes.
A boat race down a river with buoys to pass and rocks to avoid.
Players take turns dropping blocks onto a wobbling tower; whoever makes it fall loses.
A memory game: tiles light up in a sequence and players repeat it by walking onto them; the sequence grows.
Jetpack race: hold jump to fly upward through hoops in a canyon; fuel refills on landing.
Wizard duel: players cast fireballs and shields with face buttons; three hits and you are out.
Bumper cars in an arena with ramps; points for every hit, double for hits from behind.
